title: Bring your own: Switchyard, Hermes Agent, Mem0

efficient_model.help: the model id of Switchyard's efficient tier

steps.text: Build Switchyard yourself: cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Switchyard --tag v0.3.0 switchyard-server
Hermes needs its OpenAI-compatible base URL set to http://127.0.0.1:8787 by hand; install does not write it. Mem0 joins by its own means.
